title:
A strategy subtype which relies on the user to determine the bins for subjects. Because of the "static nature" of the
mapping, this strategy expects all ids to be present in the mapping. If an id doesn't exist in the mapping, then its
assumed to be "un-binned" and no bins will be returned for those.
* Please note that it's the user's responsibility to {@link #init} the strategy by providing the explicit mapping.
name: Persistable.Bin.Strategy.Custom
